reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye—let alone the only man-made structure visible—is a well-documented myth. According to NASA and reports from astronauts, the Great Wall cannot be seen from low Earth orbit without magnification because it is narrow (typically only about 6 to 9 meters wide) and made of materials that blend into the surrounding landscape. Furthermore, many other man-made structures and features, such as highways, airports, dams, and cities at night, are actually visible from low Earth orbit with the naked eye.
